notes.title: Updates
notes.notes:
17/5/18
Tweaked the vine grabbing cooldown so hopefully you don't restick to vines while jumping off and holding diag. 

Fixed a bug where if you spent too much time in the air while playing on vines, the game would think you hit terminal velocity and splatter you the next time you touched a platform.

notes.title: Launch
notes.notes:
Hiya folks, just an update.

Pricing has been fixed but it turns out not even Americans could purchase. I contacted Valve last night but no response as of yet. Hopefully this will be resolved soon.
